div.head: II Cn 29
div.ab: And gyf hwa þeof gemete ⁊ hine his þances aweg læte butan hreame, gebete be þæs ðeofes were oððe hine mid fullan aðe geladige, þæt he him nan facn mid nyste.
And gif hwa þeof gemete ⁊ hine his þances anweg læte buton hreame, gebete be þæs þeofes were oððe hine mid fullum aðe ge[ladige], þæt he him nan facn mide nyste.
Si quis furi obuiabit et gratis eum sine clamore (uociferatione) dimiserit, emendet secundum weram ipsius furis aut plena láda se adlegiet, quod cum eo falsum (dolum) nesciuit.
⁊ gyf hwá ðeof gemete ⁊ hine his ðances aweg lǽte buton réame, gebete be ðæs ðeofes wére oððe hine mid fullum aðe geladige, þæt he him mid nan facn nyste.

And if anyone comes upon a thief and of his own accord lets him escape without raising the hue and cry, he shall make compensation by the payment of the thief's wergeld, or clear himself with the full oath, [asserting] that he did not know him to be guilty of any crime.

Und wenn einer einen Dieb trifft und ihn absichtlich hinweg lässt ohne Gerüfte, büsse er durch Zahlung des Wergeldes des Diebes oder reinige sich mit vollem Eide, dass er kein Verbrechen an jenem gekannt habe.

And if anyone meets a thief and deliberately lets him go without raising the hue and cry, let him pay compensation at the thief's wergild or clear himself with a full oath that he knew of no crime in him.
div.note: A ends f. 9 with ‘ge’ and forgets ‘-ladige’ on the next page. Ld has ‘al. lade’ in the margin. Liebermann compares Ine 36; IV As 6.3.
